CARDIAC CATHETERIZATION REPORT

Patient underwent left heart catheterization and coronary angiography for
evaluation of chest pain.

Findings: Left ventriculography demonstrated LVEF estimated at 35%, consistent
with moderately reduced systolic function. Coronary angiography revealed
severe stenosis of the LAD (90% narrowing) with moderate disease in the right
coronary artery.

Labs: Troponin 0.04 ng/mL on admission, repeat troponin trending downward.

Impression: Severe single-vessel coronary artery disease with reduced left
ventricular function.
